---
title: "Advanced Workshops"
subtitle: "Eight modules. Each has five slide decks with a self-check quiz, five R labs and a two-page cheat sheet."
format:

    page-layout: full
---

Every module runs on its own synthetic dataset. Open a session to see the slides; the lab file named on the lab slide is in the downloads on the [welcome page](welcome.qmd). Quiz scores are kept in your browser and can be saved as a text file from the last quiz slide.
